title: Impact of Additional Representative on Public Spending

llm_response.content:
## 1. Identification Strategy

The research question aims to determine if an additional representative, allocated based on a population threshold, affects public spending per capita. This scenario presents a classic application for a **Regression Discontinuity Design (RDD)**.

**Why RDD?**
The treatment (receiving a second representative) is assigned sharply based on whether a district's population (`running_var`) crosses a specific, known threshold. Districts just above the threshold receive the additional representative, while those just below do not. _ground_truth.conclusion_detail: The presence of a second representative decreases public spending per capita.
